modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On October 15, 2003: China launches Shenzhou 5, its first crewed space mission.
On October 15, 1994: The United States, under the Clinton administration, returns Haiti's first democratically elected president, Jean-Bertrand Aristide, to the island.
On October 15, 1956: FORTRAN, the first modern computer language, is first shared with the coding community.
On October 15, 1910: Airship America is launched from New Jersey in the first attempt to cross the Atlantic by a powered aircraft.
On October 15, 2001: NASA's Galileo spacecraft passes within 112 miles (180 km) of Jupiter's moon Io.
